name: Flat

children.name: Increased Strength
children.local_notes: House rule: ST covers striking & lifting only (8/level); HP bought separately.

children.name: Extra Hit Points
children.local_notes: Includes HP formerly bundled with ST.

children.name: Mods
children.local_notes: Canon: 'Implants: None.' No biomods, no mesh inserts, no cortical stack. A Flat ages, sickens, sleeps eight hours, and dies for real unless implants are purchased separately.

children.name: Morph Price Adjustment
children.local_notes: Sets this morph to its chargen price: 0 EP CP / 4 = 0 points. Package value 216, adjustment -216. The package total says what the body is; the chargen price is all you pay for it, and only at creation (Part III).

local_notes: Unmodified baseline human (EP 1e, 0 CP / 0 pts). ST 10, HT 10, HP 18, nothing else. The only truly mortal body on this list.
